name: Meneltarma
hint: the Pillar of Heaven, tall mountain near the middle of the Mittalmar; the Hallow of Eru on its flat summit

name: Tarmasundar
hint: the Roots of the Pillar: five long low ridges running out from the Meneltarma toward the five promontories

name: Sorontil
hint: great height in the north of the Forostar rising sheer from the sea in tall cliffs; eagles nested here

name: Highlands of the Forostar
hint: descriptive name: the rocky, stony uplands of the Forostar, the least fertile part of the isle

name: Oromet
hint: hill near the haven of Andúnië in the far west; Tar-Minastir built a tower on it to gaze west

name: Highlands of the Andustar
hint: descriptive name: the rocky northern Andustar, high land with fir-woods above the northern cliffs

name: Hills of Orrostar
hint: approx: descriptive name; the highlands toward the northern end of the Orrostar

name: Cliffs of Hyarnustar
hint: descriptive name: the mountainous west of the Hyarnustar, ending in great cliffs on the sea

name: Siril
hint: chief river of Númenor: rises under the Meneltarma in Noirinan and runs south to the sea through marshes and reedy flats

name: Nunduinë
hint: river of the west that spreads into the lake Nísinen and reaches the sea at Eldalondë in the Bay of Eldanna

name: Nísinen
hint: small lake on the Nunduinë above Eldalondë, in the land of Nísimaldar, famed for its sweet-scented flowers

name: Forests of Hyarrostar
hint: descriptive name: the great timber woods of the south-east, where Aldarion planted many trees for ship-building

name: Fir-woods of the Andustar
hint: descriptive name: fir forests on the high northern Andustar facing the sea

name: Marshes of the Siril
hint: descriptive name: the delta of the Siril, marshes and reedy flats at the sea

name: Road from Rómenna to Andúnië
hint: the paved highway of the kings: Rómenna, Armenelos, the Valley of the Tombs, Ondosto in the Forostar, then west to Andúnië

name: Ascent of the Meneltarma
hint: the path that wound up the mountain from the Valley of the Tombs to the Hallow on the summit

name: Armenelos
hint: City of the Kings in Arandor, founded by Elros; the King's House and later the Temple of Sauron

name: King's Court and Nimloth
hint: courts of the King's House in Armenelos where the White Tree Nimloth grew until Ar-Pharazôn had it burned

name: Temple of Armenelos
hint: the great domed temple that Sauron raised on the hill in the midst of the city; human sacrifices to Melkor

name: Rómenna
hint: the great eastern haven at the head of its firth; home of the Faithful in the last days

name: Tol Uinen
hint: small isle in the Bay of Rómenna, hallowed to Uinen

name: Calmindon
hint: the Light-tower that Aldarion built on Tol Uinen

name: Bay of Rómenna
hint: the eastern bay between Orrostar and Hyarrostar, with the long firth of Rómenna at its head

name: Andúnië
hint: haven in the far west of the Andustar, facing toward Eressëa; seat of the Lords of Andúnië

name: House of the Lords of Andúnië
hint: approx: the hall of Valandil's line, Lords of Andúnië, until Ar-Gimilzôr moved them to Rómenna

name: Bay of Andúnië
hint: bay in the far west of the Andustar on which Andúnië stands

name: Tower of Tar-Minastir
hint: tall tower that Tar-Minastir built on the hill of Oromet to look toward the West

name: Western bays of the Andustar
hint: three small bays facing west in the high western end of the Andustar; the northernmost is the Bay of Andúnië

name: Eldalondë
hint: Eldalondë the Green, haven at the mouth of the Nunduinë where the ships of the Eldar of Eressëa came

name: Bay of Eldanna
hint: the great bay between the Andustar and the Hyarnustar, facing toward Eressëa

name: Ondosto
hint: town in the south of the Forostar on the road from Armenelos west to Andúnië; near the stone-quarries

name: Tower of Tar-Meneldur
hint: approx: the tall tower in the north of the Forostar near Sorontil, from which King Meneldur watched the stars

name: Nindamos
hint: chief fishing village of the south coast, on the east side of the mouths of the Siril

name: Noirinan
hint: the Valley of the Tombs, between the south-west and south-east roots of the Meneltarma

name: Tombs of the Kings
hint: the tombs hewn in the rock at the head of Noirinan, under the mountain

name: Hallow of Eru
hint: the unroofed high place on the summit of the Meneltarma, hallowed to Eru Ilúvatar; the Three Prayers

name: White House of Erendis
hint: approx: the house that Aldarion built for Erendis in Emerië, where she later lived apart

name: Vineyards of Hyarnustar
hint: descriptive name: the vine-lands in the east and south of the Hyarnustar

name: Pastures of the Mittalmar
hint: descriptive name: the raised grass-lands of the Inlands, chiefly sheep and cattle country

name: Grain-lands of Orrostar
hint: descriptive name: the inner Orrostar, cool but good for grain

name: Forostar
hint: radius about 170 km. the Northlands, rocky and least fertile; Sorontil and Ondosto

name: Andustar
hint: radius about 170 km. the Westlands; Andúnië, Oromet, fir-woods in the north

name: Hyarnustar
hint: radius about 170 km. the South-west lands; vineyards and great cliffs

name: Hyarrostar
hint: radius about 170 km. the South-east lands; great forests

name: Orrostar
hint: radius about 170 km. the Eastlands; grain and northern hills

name: Mittalmar
hint: radius about 190 km. the Inlands, raised pasture-land around the Meneltarma

name: Arandor
hint: radius about 60 km. the Kingsland, the eastern Mittalmar with Armenelos and Rómenna

name: Emerië
hint: radius about 40 km. the sheep-pastures of the south-west Mittalmar; home of Erendis

name: Nísimaldar
hint: radius about 40 km. the land of fragrant evergreen trees around Eldalondë and the Bay of Eldanna

name: Hyarastorni
hint: radius about 25 km. approx: the sheep-lands of Hallatan, kinsman of Aldarion, near Emerië
